title: ICM Price Oracle
summary: Chainlink prices on your L1 over ICM
description: Brings Chainlink Data Feeds from the C-Chain to an Avalanche L1 that has no oracle. A publisher on the C-Chain pushes prices, or answers requests, over ICM; a consumer on the L1 stores them and refuses stale or out-of-order rounds.
prompts: My L1 needs the AVAX price but Chainlink isn't deployed there
Bridge oracle prices from the C-Chain to my L1
Cross-chain request and response between C-Chain and an L1

home.description: C-Chain with Chainlink Data Feeds, where the publisher lives

params.name: owner
params.description: Owns the publisher and the consumer

params.name: updateGasLimit
params.description: Gas for the consumer to store an update. A first update measured about 75,000.

params.name: requestGasLimit
params.description: Gas for the publisher to read the feed and send the answer. Measured about 155,000 including the Teleporter send.

params.name: maxAge
params.description: Seconds after the source round at which the L1 treats a price as stale

prerequisites: An L1 with interoperability enabled and a relayer to the C-Chain: l1-quickstart with enableManagedRelayer does both
Native gas on both chains for the signer

contracts.name: PriceFeedPublisher
contracts.description: Reads Chainlink on the C-Chain and sends prices over ICM

contracts.name: PriceFeedConsumer
contracts.description: Stores prices on the L1 and requests fresh ones

contracts.name: TeleporterMessenger
contracts.description: Used to confirm delivery with messageReceived

steps.title: Make sure a relayer serves both chains
Deploy the publisher on the C-Chain
Deploy the consumer on the L1
Transfer the publisher to its owner
Wait for the price to reach the L1

checks.description: The L1 holds a fresh AVAX/USD price

review: The consumer accepts messages only from the TeleporterMessenger, and only from the publisher fixed at deployment.
The publisher answers only trusted consumers and only REQUEST messages.
Updates with an updatedAt at or before the stored one are ignored, so retries and reordering cannot roll prices back.
maxAge on the L1 is at least the feed's heartbeat plus relay time; Fuji feeds can go hours between rounds.

frontend.summary: Live prices on the L1, brought over from Chainlink on the C-Chain, with how fresh each one is.
audience: Users of apps on the L1 who need prices
journeys: A price board: pair, price and 'updated 2 minutes ago', readable without a wallet.
Refresh a price with one button and a status through Requested and Updated; it crosses chains twice, so say it takes about a minute.
A stale price shows as 'refreshing', never as an error page.
flows: Read latestPrice(pair) on the L1; format with the stored decimals and show the age from updatedAt.
Refresh by calling requestPrice(pair) on the L1, then wait for PriceUpdated on the L1; the answer takes two relayer hops.
For always-fresh prices, run a keeper that calls publish(pair, l1BlockchainIdHex, consumer) on the C-Chain on a schedule.
Treat a StalePrice revert as 'refreshing', not as an error page.
